[[Eyja]] is a [[consumable crafter]], an NPC who can craft certain [[consumable]]s. Your [[character]] must have achieved rank 3 in the [[Norn rank]] [[title]] track (i.e. Slayer of Nightmares).

==Dialogue==
{{Consumable crafter dialogue}}

Before attaining rank 3 on the Norn title track:
:''"Well, if it isn't <character name>. We've heard tales of your adventures, traveler, but they are short fiction compared to the epic deeds of the Norn. If you want my help, then you must prove your strength by becoming a Slayer of Nightmares."''
